dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: The smell of Grilled Fish covered in Mint Sauce... Mint Sauce...

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Oho... When you tear open the crispy skin, the shiny fishy flesh inside couldn't be more like freshly-made competition equipment if it tried...

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: And as an engineer, I'm the first person that gets to experience it!

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: ...Of course, our testing equipment is meant for safety inspections, which is a whole other kettle of fish from grilling, well, fish.

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Oho... Such a cool texture, and what a refreshing aftertaste. Just like placing your hand on a machine that's just been wiped clean...

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Ahh, the smell of steel, as fresh as a handful of Mint!

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: ...Of course, you can eat Mint, but I'd advise against actually trying to taste an ice-cold Iron Chunk.

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Goodbye... Let's go for Grilled Fish together sometime!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure safety still comes into play when grilling fish, right?

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: True, you do need to be careful with both the fire and the ingredients used. Things could get really ugly if you ate poisonous fish! That would be like using cracked components!

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Indeed. Of course, you won't often find cold metal around these parts.

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Or in simpler terms, everyone can just use processed materials.
